## Available Hitters

### Table can be Filtered, sorted, and/or searched on each column.
```{r}
datatable(
  hit |> rename(`1b` = X1b,`2b` = X2b,`3b` = X3b),
  rownames = FALSE,
  extensions = list("Buttons",'FixedHeader'),
  filter = list(position="top",clear=FALSE),
  options = list(
    lengthChange = FALSE,
    paging = F,
    scrollY = T,
    scroller = TRUE,
    scrollX = T,
    search = list(regex = TRUE,caseInsensitive = TRUE),
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
  )
)
```

## Team Usage Totals

These numbers are calculated as follows:

* `SP` is the total starts by pitchers on their roster. Each team will need to cover 160 starts; rosters with fewer than 160 starts have their starts highlighted in red in the table below.
* `RP` is the total BF by pitchers with an RP rating. A team generally uses around 2000 BF per season. Overcounting appears for pitchers with starts and a relief rating. In practice, a dual pitcher used as a starter and a reliever will have fewer relief BF available due to their starts.
* `PA` is the team's total plate appearances, which generally exceeds 6000 each season.
* Each position total is calculated by the total number of PA by those players on the roster eligible to play that position. In this table, a player eligible at multiple positions will have all of their PA added to each of their positions, resulting in over-counting. 


```{r, results='asis'}
use |> 
  mutate(across(GS,
         ~ cell_spec(
      .x,
      format = "html",
      background = ifelse(.x < 160, "red", "white"),
      color = ifelse(.x < 160, "white", "black")
    )
  ) )|> 
  mutate(across(Relief_BF,
         ~ cell_spec(
      .x,
      format = "html",
      background = ifelse(.x < 2000, "red", "white"),
      color = ifelse(.x < 2000, "white", "black")
    )
  ) )|> 
  mutate(across(PA_tot,
         ~ cell_spec(
      .x,
      format = "html",
      background = ifelse(.x < 6000, "red", "white"),
      color = ifelse(.x < 6000, "white", "black")
    )
  ) )|> 
  mutate(across(
    all_of(5:12),
    ~ cell_spec(
      .x,
      format = "html",
      background = ifelse(.x < 650, "red", "white"),
      color = ifelse(.x < 650, "white", "black")
    )
  )) |> 
  kbl(
    align = 'lccccccccccc',
    escape = F,
    col.names = c('Team','SP','RP','PA','c','1b','2b','3b','ss','lf','cf','rf'),
    booktabs = T) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = T, color = 'seagreen', border_right = T) |>
  column_spec(2:4, bold = T) |> 
  #column_spec(2, width = '25em') |> 
  #column_spec(3, width = '25em', color = 'seagreen')
  kable_styling(font_size = 16,  full_width = F,fixed_thead = T)
```
